captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a coarse, low-resolution screw thread segment. It features a thick helical profile with a prominent double-start thread wrapping around a central core. The outer surface is faceted rather than smooth, clearly showing the 16-sided polygon segments used to construct its cross-section.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric low-resolution screw thread script in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the base radius, profile depth, total length, thread lead, and number of starts to generate custom helical screw profiles.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining a 16-point custom 2D polygon whose vertices are calculated using mathematical functions to represent a multi-start thread profile. This 2D shape is then transformed into a 3D screw segment using linear_extrude with a calculated twist angle based on the thread lead, length, and starts, utilizing a low fragment count ($fn=16).
